title: Rugby Motion Play
description: A declarative rugby union play for the Rugby Motion renderer. Coordinates are metres in canonical pitch space: x is across the field and y is along its length. With attacking_direction set to toward_top, smaller y values are further forward on screen.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this JSON Schema file. It does not affect runtime rendering.

schema_version.description: The play-file schema version. The current supported version is 1.

title.description: The title shown in the visualization. Project typography settings control its font and size.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting text shown below the title. Project typography settings control its font and size.

attacking_direction.description: The attacking direction in the canonical pitch coordinate system. The current portrait renderer uses toward_top; other values are reserved for future camera transforms.

duration.description: Total play length in seconds. Player keyframes, ball events, annotations, and title-card times must fall within this interval.

teams.description: Visual team definitions. Every player's team should refer to one of these IDs.

players.description: The numbered player tokens in this play. Player IDs are local to this file.

annotations.description: Optional on-screen annotations with an authored visibility interval.

finiteNumber.description: A finite numeric value. JSON numbers must not be NaN or Infinity.

behind.description: Metres away from the attacking direction.

fieldMarking.description: A rugby union field marking requested by the play data. The current renderer intentionally uses a full green diagram surface rather than an exact touchline-bounded pitch, so gain_line is the primary rendered marking. Other standard marking names are retained in the schema for authoring intent and future rendering modes.

ease.description: Timing curve for movement to this keyframe. If a relative keyframe omits ease, the referenced player's same-time ease may be inherited.

t.description: Time in seconds from play start. Keyframes must be monotonically ordered for each player.

x.description: Absolute across-field coordinate in metres. Provide x and y together.

y.description: Absolute lengthwise coordinate in metres. Provide x and y together.

relative_to.description: ID of another player in this same play whose position at time t is the reference.

from_previous.description: Resolve this later keyframe from this player's immediately previous resolved keyframe, then apply offset_m.

offset_m.description: Human-readable offset from relative_to or from_previous. Use forward/behind and left/right instead of manually matching coordinates.

playerKeyframe.description: A player's position at time t. The first keyframe must define an absolute or relative position. Later keyframes may use from_previous with offset_m to move independently from that player's previous resolved position, or may hold the previous position if a position is omitted in the implementation's supported shorthand.

id.description: Team ID used by players in this play.
Player ID local to this play.

number.description: Jersey number shown inside the token.

team.description: ID of a team in this play's teams array.

keyframes.description: Monotonically timed motion track. Positions are interpolated between keyframes and the final position is held.

from.description: ID of the current ball carrier at release.

to.description: ID of the receiving player. Their position is sampled at arrival; do not author ball coordinates.

curve.description: Pass flight shape. Straight is currently implemented; arc/lob are reserved by the broader spec.

from.description: ID of the current ball carrier at release.

target.description: Explicit pitch target. Unlike a pass receiver, this is intentionally a literal coordinate.

starts_with.description: Player ID holding the ball at t=0.

events.description: Chronological ball events. Passes must form a carrier chain: each event's from must be the previous carrier.

t.description: At this timestamp the gain line snaps to the ball's position. t=0 and t=duration are implicit defaults; add only intermediate updates.

show_markings.description: Names of standard rugby union markings to show. Omit a marking to keep the visualization simpler for a given play.

gain_line.description: Optional intermediate gain-line update times. The resolved line is always at the ball; start and end timestamps are implicit.

mode.description: Auto centers on used play bounds; fixed uses center/size; scenes is reserved for camera cuts.

padding_m.description: Padding around the used player/ball bounds in auto mode.

size.description: Width/height in metres for fixed viewport mode; x is width and y is height.
